explication: Apache NiFi is a data-processing and distribution platform; this source selection also exposes its MiNiFi C2 client and protocol. The documented user journey is to design and manage pipelines through the browser or REST API, then process and distribute data with delivery guarantees and provenance. The graph includes those documented product capabilities alongside the more specific C2 heartbeat, command, and transport components visible in the tree. Source excerpts are sparse, so several application-level relationships are documented or explicitly unverified rather than inferred from module names.
